I've been making a recipe off of e-liquid-recipes.com for a few months that was a nice tobacco. Sadly, I ran out of the two main flavors mid-batch and had to substitute. Oddly enough, it takes half as long to cure/steep and it has a nice sour kick to it. And like its progenitor recipe, it leaves the room smelling nice.

'Bacco & Sour Crème

  • 3.33 % Black Honey Tobacco (TFA)
  • 3.33 % Bavarian Creme (TFA)
  • 1.67 % 555 Type Dark Tobacco (TFA)
  • 1.67 % Greek Yogurt (TFA)
  • 0.50 % Ethyl Maltol 10%

I let it age for a week, then had to try it. I'll update in a week or so with any progress on flavor change with a longer steep/cure time.

Thanks for the inspiration!
